dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit dark, jagged perimeters with sharp gradient transitions to lighter gray/white interiors, concentrated across the upper dorsal and lateral-mid sections.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid dark low-intensity pixel clusters localized between macro-annuli structures; sparse high-intensity white specular blobs are present in the lower left quadrant where light interacts with surface moisture.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal 'O' structures form an irregular quadrilateral, while a subset of three lateral structures forms a right-leaning triangle oriented toward the posterior.
